description: Open the NDRT Rocket 2020 design at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/NDRT_Rocket_2020.ork in OpenRocket as a reference. Then create a new rocket design (File > New) and build a two-stage rocket from scratch. The rocket should have: (1) A sustainer stage with a nose cone, body tube, fins, parachute, and motor mount; (2) A booster stage below the sustainer with its own body tube, fins, and motor mount. Use the 'Add stage' button or right-click menu to add a second stage. Ensure both stages have at least basic components (body tube + fins + motor mount each). Save the completed two-stage rocket design as /home/ga/Documents/rockets/my_two_stage_rocket.ork using File > Save As.
